label: IDF Strike Kills 2 Hamas Militants, 1 Nukhba Fighter — Deir al-Balah (Aug 24, 2026)
sub: IDF struck and killed two Hamas militants in Deir al-Balah overnight into Monday, August 24, 2026, one identified as a member of Hamas's elite Nukhba force from the October 7, 2023 attack. IDF said the pair were planning attacks on Israeli troops and rebuilding Hamas capabilities.

label: Netanyahu, Katz Threaten to Intensify Strikes Over Gaza Kites (Aug 23, 2026)
sub: After kites flown from Gaza landed in Kibbutz Nahal Oz, Netanyahu and Katz warned the IDF would intensify strikes and evacuate areas launching kites, drones, and balloons if it did not stop. Hamas dismissed the objects as children's toys.

label: Az-Zawayda Strike Kills 4-Year-Old Near Aid Site (Aug 23, 2026)
sub: IAF strike on a Hamas weapons-production site in Az-Zawayda, near an aid distribution point, killed 4-year-old Mohammad Abdel-Salam Taha and wounded at least 6 others on August 23, 2026.

label: Hamas Weapons-Production Cmdr Abu Ful Killed — Maghazi Camp (Aug 23, 2026)
sub: IAF strike killed Ismail Abu Ful, commander of a Hamas weapons-production site near an aid distribution point, in Al-Maghazi refugee camp on August 23, 2026.

label: Hamas Cmdr Sharif al-Hasanat Killed — Deir al-Balah (Aug 22, 2026)
sub: Israeli drone strike on the al-Hasanat family home in Deir al-Balah killed Sharif al-Hasanat (44), a Hamas Deir al-Balah Battalion company commander, on August 22, 2026.

label: IDF Strike Kills Hamas Cmdr Qawari — Khan Younis (Aug 14, 2026)
sub: Israeli aerial strike killed Hudhaifa Khaled Suleiman Qawari, a Hamas Khan Younis Brigade company commander, on August 14, 2026. IDF said he had trained fighters, moved weapons, and advanced attacks on IDF troops.

label: IDF Strike Kills Hamas Cmdr Mushtaha — Northern Gaza (Jul 30, 2026, revealed Aug 14)
sub: IDF airstrike in northern Gaza on July 30, 2026 killed Muhammad Bassam Mushtaha, a commander in Hamas's Al-Shati battalion who held Israeli hostages taken on October 7, 2023. The strike was only publicly confirmed by the IDF on August 14, 2026.

label: 19 Bodies Recovered From Karam Building Rubble — Gaza City (Aug 8, 2026)
sub: Gaza Civil Defence concluded a four-day recovery operation on August 8, 2026, retrieving 19 bodies — mostly women and children — from the destroyed 'Karam' residential building on al-Sinaa Street, western Gaza City, using rudimentary tools due to a lack of heavy machinery.

label: Netanyahu, Katz Quietly Approve 'Green Rafah' Reconstruction (Aug 9, 2026)
sub: Israeli media reported Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz quietly approved infrastructure and temporary-housing reconstruction work in 'Green Rafah,' an IDF-controlled area of eastern Rafah inside the Yellow Line, made ~2 weeks earlier without public announcement. The PMO called it an Emirati-backed pilot project underway for months, supervised by the Israeli military.

label: Sheikh Ajlin Strike — 2 Killed (Aug 3, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrike hit the Sheikh Ajlin neighborhood of Gaza City on August 3, 2026, killing two people, ending nearly 24 hours without a strike. Weekend toll reached 26 killed.

label: PIJ Commander Fatair Killed — Deir al-Balah (Weekend, Aug 2, 2026)
sub: IDF strike killed Mahmoud Fatair, PIJ Central Gaza Brigade commander who held hostage Rom Braslavski captive for 738 days and took part in the Oct 7, 2023 Nova festival attack.

label: Al-Masri Family of 6 Killed — Sabra, Gaza City (Jul 21, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrike killed the Al-Masri family of six as they slept: Firas, wife Salsabeel, and their 4 children (ages 6-13). IDF confirmed the strike, saying its target was a Hamas militant.

label: Drone Strikes Funeral Procession — Nuseirat Camp: 8 Killed (Jul 17, 2026)
sub: Israeli drone struck a funeral procession outside Ahmad Yassin Mosque in Nuseirat camp, killing 8 mourners and wounding 20. IDF said it targeted a PIJ cell. Day toll across Gaza: 14 killed.

label: Tal al-Hawa Drone Strike (Jul 12-13, 2026)
sub: Israeli drone strike on a motorcycle in Tal al-Hawa, southern Gaza City, killed Osama Naim Shamlakh and wounded 9 civilians. Part of a wave of attacks killing 3, wounding 15 across Gaza.

label: Netanyahu Rejects US 15-Point Gaza Plan (Aug 9, 2026)
sub: Netanyahu rejected the US-brokered 15-point Gaza roadmap accepted by Hamas on August 9, 2026, saying no IDF withdrawal until Hamas is genuinely disarmed. Israel had maintained a 5-day pause on Gaza strikes and kept forces behind the Yellow Line even while publicly rejecting the plan.

label: Al-Sousi Tower Strike — Abu Taif Family Killed (Aug 2, 2026)
sub: Israeli air raid on Al-Sousi Tower, western Gaza City, killed Abdullah Abu Taif, his pregnant wife Abeer Anan, and their 5-year-old son Azzam on August 2, 2026 — part of a 19-killed day, the largest daily toll in weeks.

label: Al-Qarara Strike — Al-Hams Family Killed (Aug 2, 2026)
sub: Israeli strike on an apartment in al-Qarara, northwest of Khan Younis, killed three members of the Al-Hams family on August 2, 2026.

label: Remal Neighborhood Drone Strike (Aug 2, 2026)
sub: Israeli drone strike on a tent sheltering displaced people in the Remal neighborhood, west of Gaza City, killed 2 people on August 2, 2026.

label: Al-Aqsa Hospital Medicine Warehouses Destroyed (Aug 1, 2026)
sub: Overnight Israeli strike destroyed 2 of 4 medicine storage warehouses at Al-Aqsa Martyrs Hospital, Deir al-Balah, and badly damaged the other 2, on August 1, 2026 — 2 days after the Board of Peace disarmament agreement was announced.

label: Sabra: 112 Bodies Recovered From 2023 Strike Rubble (Aug 1, 2026)
sub: Civil Defence completed a 17-day operation recovering 112 bodies — 40 children among them — from the rubble of homes hit by an Israeli strike on Nov 23, 2023 in Sabra, south of Gaza City. Mass funeral held Aug 4, 2026.

label: Strikes Amid Board of Peace Disarmament Announcement (Jul 30, 2026)
sub: Israeli strikes killed at least 6 Palestinians including children in Khan Younis, Bureij, and Gaza City on the same day Trump announced the Board of Peace Hamas disarmament agreement.

label: North Gaza Police Chief Maqadma Killed — Sheikh Radwan (Jul 25, 2026)
sub: Israeli air strike killed Brigadier-General Abdel-Nasser al-Maqadma, head of the Hamas-run police force and governor of northern Gaza, in the Sheikh Radwan area on July 25, 2026.

label: Jabalia Al-Faluja Police Station Strike — 8 Killed (Jul 14, 2026)
sub: Israeli strike on a police station in Jabalia's al-Faluja area killed 8, including 6 officers, on July 14, 2026. Gaza's Interior Ministry called it a "horrific massacre."

label: Al-Mawasi Displacement Tent Strike (Jul 8, 2026)
sub: Israeli strike on a tent sheltering displaced people in al-Mawasi, Khan Younis, killed at least 4 including a 10-year-old on July 8, 2026.

label: Al-Zawayda Drone Strike — 1 Killed (June 2, 2026)
sub: IDF drone strike in Al-Zawayda (central Gaza) on June 2, 2026 (Day 965) killed one Palestinian, Khamis Joweifil, and wounded two others. Source: IMEMC.

label: Jabalia Camp: Homes Burned, Drone Attack on Displaced (June 2, 2026)
sub: Israeli forces set fires to dozens of homes in Jabalia refugee camp (northern Gaza) on June 2, 2026 (Day 965). Apache helicopters circled overhead as a drone dropped explosives on a tent sheltering displaced families. Source: IMEMC.

label: Gaza Seaport Cafe Strike — 2 Killed, 12 Wounded (May 31, 2026)
sub: Israeli Apache helicopter struck a crowded cafe at the emergency seaport off Gaza City coast on May 31, 2026 (Day 963), killing 2 and wounding 12. Multiple sources confirmed via Reuters, Al-Monitor, Arab News.

label: Gaza City Residential Building Strike — 10 Killed Including 4 Children (May 28, 2026)
sub: IDF airstrike on a residential building in Gaza City on May 28, 2026 (Day 960) killed at least 10 people including four children and wounded 20+. Hamas Gaza City Brigade deputy commander Imad Aslim was also killed in a separate May 28 strike in the area.

label: Tel al-Sultan Displacement Camp Strike — Rafah (May 26, 2026)
sub: IDF struck the Tel al-Sultan displacement camp in Rafah on May 26, 2026 (Day 958 / Eid eve), killing at least 45 people. Israel said it targeted two senior Hamas officials. The strike sparked a border skirmish in which one Egyptian soldier was killed. Egypt summoned the Israeli ambassador.

label: Hamas Military Wing Chief Odeh Killed — Rimal, Gaza City (May 26, 2026)
sub: IDF/Shin Bet strike in Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City on May 26, 2026 (Day 958) killed Mohammed Odeh, newly-appointed commander of Hamas's Qassam Brigades, along with his wife and two children (5 total killed, 12 wounded). He was the 4th Qassam Brigades chief killed since Oct. 7, 2023 — eliminated just 11 days after predecessor al-Haddad.

label: IDF Strike — Central Gaza Police Station (May 24, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrike on a Hamas police station in central Gaza on May 24, 2026 (Day 956) killed 7: 5 police officers, 1 child, and 1 civilian. IDF also destroyed a weapons depot with RPGs, explosives, and grenades in a separate nearby strike. Part of the ongoing renewed campaign since May 11.

label: Nuseirat Camp Airstrike — Abu Mlouh Family (May 24, 2026)
sub: IDF dawn airstrike on Nuseirat refugee camp apartment killed the Abu Mlouh family of three — father, mother, and 1-year-old son — on May 24, 2026 (Day 956). Overnight strikes also struck Deir al-Balah, causing extensive destruction.

label: Hamas Police Post Strike — Northern Gaza (May 23, 2026)
sub: IDF two-missile strike on Hamas police post in northern Gaza on May 23, 2026 (Day 955) killed 5 officers. Separately, IDF destroyed 3 Hamas weapons depots in central Gaza containing anti-tank missiles, RPGs, and firearms.

label: Overnight Strikes — Nuseirat & Bureij Camps (May 22–23, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrikes on Nuseirat and Bureij refugee camps overnight on May 22–23, 2026 (Day 955) injured dozens and caused heavy destruction to residential areas. Continued pattern of near-daily central Gaza bombardment under renewed campaign.

label: IDF Strikes — Central Gaza (Day 954, May 22, 2026)
sub: Ongoing IDF airstrikes in central Gaza Strip on Day 954 (May 22, 2026), continuing the pattern of near-daily strikes since the May 10 security cabinet authorization. Day 954 dominated by diplomatic fallout from flotilla deportations: 422 activists arrive in Turkey, multiple ambassadors summoned; Netanyahu rebukes Ben-Gvir. Cumulative toll: 73,800+ killed since Oct 7, 2023.

label: IDF Airstrike — Al-Maghazi Camp (May 21, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrike destroyed the Ismail family home in Al-Maghazi refugee camp, central Gaza Strip, on May 21, 2026 (Day 953). IDF separately killed a Hamas Nukhba force operative in central Gaza the same day. Nukhba force led the Oct 7, 2023 attacks.

label: Hamas Military Wing Chief Haddad Killed — Gaza City (May 16, 2026)
sub: IDF two-strike operation in Gaza City on May 16, 2026 (Day 948 / Day 6 of renewed campaign) killed Izz al-Din al-Haddad, head of Hamas's Gaza military wing. First strike on a residential building; second on a vehicle. 7 killed, dozens wounded. Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz confirmed. Most significant Hamas leadership strike since Mohammed Sinwar's killing on May 13, 2026.

label: IDF Intensive Strikes — Eastern Gaza City (May 15, 2026 / Nakba Day)
sub: IDF conducted intensive air and ground strikes in eastern Gaza City on May 15, 2026 (Day 947 / Day 5 of renewed campaign). Nakba Day — 78th anniversary of 1948 mass displacement — marked globally and in Gaza amid ongoing bombardment. OCHA confirmed eastern Gaza City as highest-intensity operational zone.

label: IDF Intensive Strikes — Khan Younis (May 15, 2026)
sub: IDF strikes continued in Khan Younis on May 15, 2026 (Nakba Day, Day 5 of renewed campaign). Egypt's 196th humanitarian convoy entered via Rafah auxiliary gate, but at only ~110 trucks/day vs. 600+ needed. IDF Chief of Staff Zamir statement on lesson of Oct 7 signaled continued aggressive posture.

label: Yellow Line Security Incident (May 14, 2026)
sub: IDF troops killed a Palestinian militant who crossed the Yellow Line ceasefire boundary and approached Israeli forces in southern Gaza on May 14, 2026 — Day 4 of the renewed military campaign. Reported by Jerusalem Post live blog (4:00 PM). The Yellow Line separates IDF-controlled territory (now expanded to Orange Line adding 34 sq km) from Hamas-held areas.

label: Mohammed Sinwar Killed — Gaza European Hospital Tunnel (May 13, 2026)
sub: IDF/Shin Bet struck a Hamas command tunnel 8 meters beneath the EU-funded Gaza European Hospital in Khan Yunis on May 13, 2026 (Day 945), killing Mohammed Sinwar (Hamas Gaza military commander), Muhammad Shabana (Rafah Brigade commander), and Mahdi Quara (South Khan Yunis Battalion commander). Most significant Hamas leadership strike since Yahya Sinwar's death in Oct 2024.

label: Bani Suheila Shell Strike (May 12, 2026)
sub: Israeli artillery shell killed Mohammad Annaba near the Bani Suheila roundabout in eastern Khan Younis on May 12, 2026 — Day 2 of Israel's renewed military campaign. One of four Palestinians killed that day. Reported by IMEMC.

label: Zeitoun Sniper Killing (May 12, 2026)
sub: Mohammad Khader Totah was shot dead by Israeli sniper fire in the Zeitoun neighborhood of Gaza City on May 12, 2026 — the 215th consecutive day of ceasefire violations under Israel's renewed campaign. Reported by IMEMC.

label: Hamas Tunnel Destruction Site (May 11, 2026)
sub: IDF 188th Brigade and Yahalom combat engineering unit destroyed four Hamas tunnel structures totaling ~2.5 miles east of the Yellow Line in southern Gaza on May 11, 2026. Tunnels included one used to hold Israeli hostages and living quarters of senior Hamas Khan Younis Brigade commanders, plus weapons and explosives. First major IDF ground operation under renewed war authorization.

label: Eastern Rafah Evacuation Zone (May 11, 2026)
sub: Israel issued evacuation orders for additional parts of eastern Rafah on May 11, 2026 — Day 1 of renewed military operations — directing approximately 100,000 civilians to designated humanitarian areas. IDF ground advances anticipated in eastern Rafah as part of the Southern Command's post-authorization operational plan targeting Hamas infrastructure reconstituted during the 212-day ceasefire.

label: Jabalia Drone Strike (May 9, 2026)
sub: IDF drone strike on motorcycle west of Jabalia refugee camp killed Eyad al-Motawwaq on May 9, 2026. One of several targeted strikes continuing under the nominal ceasefire as Hamas missed the Board of Peace disarmament deadline.

label: Gaza City
sub: Capital of the Gaza Strip and main urban battleground. IDF ground forces encircled and entered the city from late October 2023, fighting house-to-house in dense neighborhoods including Shejaiya and Jabalia.

label: Jabalia Camp
sub: Gaza's largest refugee camp, repeatedly struck by Israeli airstrikes. An Oct 31, 2023 strike killed at least 126 people; subsequent strikes in November 2023 killed dozens more. One of the most heavily bombed areas of the war.

label: Al-Shifa Hospital
sub: Gaza's largest medical complex, raided by IDF in November 2023 and again in March 2024. Israel claimed it housed Hamas command center; WHO and MSF reported the hospital was rendered non-functional. Major focus of international controversy.

label: Rafah
sub: Southernmost city in Gaza; became refuge for over 1.4 million displaced Palestinians before IDF launched ground operation in May 2024. Site of major hostage rescue operations and continued fighting through 2025.

label: Rafah Crossing
sub: Gaza's main border crossing with Egypt and primary entry point for humanitarian aid. Seized by IDF in May 2024; remained closed for extended periods, drastically reducing aid flows. Critical bottleneck for the humanitarian response.

label: Kerem Shalom Crossing
sub: Primary commercial crossing between Israel and Gaza. Main entry point for food and supplies. Hamas rocket strikes killed IDF soldiers at the crossing in June 2024 prompting Israel to temporarily close it. Key chokepoint for aid.

label: Khan Younis
sub: Gaza's second-largest city; major IDF ground operation from January 2024. Believed to be location of senior Hamas leadership including Yahya Sinwar. Heavily damaged; Nasser Hospital compound used as field headquarters by IDF.

label: Nasser Hospital
sub: Khan Younis's main hospital; IDF surrounded and raided in February 2024, forcing evacuation of patients. Hospital lost power and medical supplies during siege. WHO declared it non-functional after raid.

label: Deir al-Balah
sub: Central Gaza district that became main hub for displaced Palestinians and humanitarian operations. Site of World Central Kitchen convoy strike (Apr 1, 2024) killing 7 aid workers. Location of major UN humanitarian compound.

label: Al-Mawasi Humanitarian Zone
sub: Strip of coastal land designated by IDF as a humanitarian safe zone for displaced Palestinians. Over 1 million people sheltered there in tent camps. Repeatedly struck despite designation; May 2024 strike killed 45 people.

label: Beit Lahiya
sub: Northern Gaza town severely damaged in the initial ground offensive. IDF forces used the area as a staging ground for the push into Gaza City. Large civilian evacuation warnings issued. Much of the town destroyed.

label: Beit Hanoun
sub: Northeastern Gaza town adjacent to Israeli territory, one of the first areas targeted in the ground offensive. Heavily bombed in initial stages; the town was almost entirely destroyed and depopulated.

label: Shejaiya
sub: Eastern neighborhood of Gaza City and site of particularly intense urban combat. IDF fought Hamas in dense building-to-building fighting over multiple months. Major tunnel network discovered. Largely destroyed.

label: Tel al-Hawa
sub: Southwestern Gaza City neighborhood with high concentration of residential buildings. Heavily bombed; location of several UN-sheltering schools struck during fighting.

label: Nuseirat Camp
sub: Central Gaza refugee camp; site of June 8, 2024 IDF hostage rescue operation that killed over 274 Palestinians and freed 4 hostages. One of the deadliest single-day incidents of the war.

label: Bureij Camp
sub: Central Gaza refugee camp repeatedly struck in airstrikes. Overcrowded with displaced persons from northern Gaza. Infrastructure largely destroyed.

label: Maghazi Camp
sub: Central Gaza refugee camp; site of December 24, 2023 airstrike on residential buildings that killed over 70 people on Christmas Eve. Multiple subsequent strikes throughout the conflict.

label: Al-Ahli Arab Hospital
sub: Anglican-run hospital in Gaza City; site of October 17, 2023 explosion that killed hundreds. Hamas blamed Israel; Israel and US said misfired Palestinian rocket caused blast. One of most disputed incidents of the war.

label: Kerem Abu Salem (Kerem Shalom)
sub: Israel's main truck crossing into Gaza for humanitarian aid. Repeatedly contested crossing point for aid delivery. Key location for ceasefire negotiations focused on humanitarian access.

label: Erez Crossing
sub: Northern pedestrian crossing between Israel and Gaza. Attacked by Hamas on October 7 and closed since. Was the primary crossing for Palestinian workers entering Israel before the war.

label: Kibbutz Be'eri
sub: Israeli agricultural community attacked on October 7; 108 of ~1,100 residents killed — one of the highest per-capita death tolls of any community. Over 30 taken hostage. Community largely destroyed.

label: Kibbutz Kfar Aza
sub: Israeli kibbutz devastated in Hamas October 7 attack. Over 63 residents killed and dozens taken hostage. Soldiers described scenes of mass atrocities. Community evacuated and partially destroyed.

label: Nova Festival Site
sub: Site of the Supernova Sukkot Gathering music festival attacked by Hamas on October 7; 364 young people killed in the single deadliest location of the October 7 attack. Became memorial site.

label: Kibbutz Nirim
sub: Small Israeli kibbutz attacked on October 7; multiple residents killed, some taken hostage. Community evacuated and relocated. Part of the Gaza envelope communities devastated in the attack.

label: Sderot
sub: Israeli city near Gaza border; attacked on October 7 with gunmen entering the city. Police station targeted; civilians killed. Thousands evacuated as rocket attacks continue throughout the war. Israel's 'missile city' facing constant rocket fire.

label: Tal al-Sultan (Rafah)
sub: Densely packed displacement area in western Rafah. Site of May 26, 2024 Israeli airstrike that ignited tent fires killing 45 displaced Palestinians. Previously designated as humanitarian safe zone.

label: Salah al-Din Road (Netzarim Corridor)
sub: Main north-south road of Gaza; IDF established the Netzarim Corridor cutting Gaza into northern and southern halves, making movement extremely difficult for civilians. Used as main evacuation route under military conditions.

label: Netzarim Corridor
sub: IDF-established military corridor bisecting Gaza east-to-west along what was the former Israeli settlement of Netzarim. Effectively divided Gaza into north and south zones, controlling civilian movement. Maintained throughout ground operations.

label: Philadelphi Corridor
sub: Narrow strip of land along the Gaza-Egypt border. Israel insists on military control of corridor to prevent weapons smuggling via tunnels; point of major contention in ceasefire negotiations. Hamas demanded full Israeli withdrawal; Israel refused.

label: Khan Younis Displacement Camp
sub: Massive informal displacement camp south of Khan Younis hosting hundreds of thousands of internally displaced Palestinians. Tents and makeshift shelters stretched for kilometers. Limited sanitation, medical care, and food.

label: Al-Zawayda
sub: Central Gaza town that became major transit point for displaced Palestinians moving between north and south Gaza. Location of humanitarian aid distribution points.

label: Beach (Shati) Camp
sub: Coastal refugee camp in Gaza City; heavily struck in the air campaign. Dense population made evacuation difficult. Sustained severe damage throughout the campaign against northern Gaza.

label: Al-Quds Hospital
sub: PRCS-operated hospital in Gaza City that struggled to function without fuel, power, or supplies. Repeatedly at center of warnings about hospital closures. Partially operational during some periods.

label: Jordanian Field Hospital
sub: Field hospital established by Jordan near Khan Younis to treat wounded Palestinians. One of several Arab-nation field hospitals deployed in Gaza. Critical backup for overwhelmed permanent health facilities.

label: European Hospital
sub: Major medical facility in Khan Younis; became one of the most important functioning hospitals in southern Gaza. Treated thousands of war wounded. Struggled with power, supplies, and overcrowding throughout the war.

label: Kamal Adwan Hospital
sub: Main hospital in northern Beit Lahiya; repeatedly besieged and struck. IDF raided in December 2024, arrested director Dr. Hussam Abu Safiya. Became symbol of healthcare system collapse in northern Gaza.

label: Erez Industrial Zone
sub: Former joint Israeli-Palestinian industrial zone on Gaza's northern border. Seized by Hamas on October 7. Israeli forces subsequently regained control. Area heavily bombed.

label: Gaza Perimeter Fence
sub: Israel's multi-layer security barrier that Hamas breached at approximately 30 points on October 7, 2023. The fence system, which cost approximately $1 billion to build, was overwhelmed by coordinated attacks using paragliders, bulldozers, and motorcycles.

label: Sinwar Elimination Site (Rafah)
sub: Location in Tal al-Sultan area of Rafah where Hamas supreme leader Yahya Sinwar was killed on October 16, 2024 during an IDF infantry patrol encounter. Identified posthumously via DNA and fingerprints.

label: US Temporary Floating Pier (JLOTS)
sub: US military temporary floating pier constructed off Gaza coast in May 2024 to deliver humanitarian aid by sea. Repeatedly damaged by rough weather and had to be towed to Israel for repairs. Delivered very limited quantities of aid before being dismantled.

label: UNRWA HQ Gaza
sub: UNRWA headquarters and primary coordination center for UN relief operations in Gaza. Surrounded by fighting throughout the conflict. Israel alleged Hamas maintained tunnels under UNRWA premises; UNRWA disputed these claims.

label: Tuffah (Khan Younis)
sub: Neighborhood in Khan Younis where some of the most intense urban combat took place during the January–April 2024 IDF operation. Hamas fighters used tunnel networks extensively for ambushes and resupply.

label: World Central Kitchen Strike Site
sub: Location where IDF missiles struck three World Central Kitchen aid vehicles on April 1, 2024, killing 7 aid workers in clearly marked humanitarian convoy. Strike triggered global outrage. IDF fired two officers after investigation.

label: Kuwait Roundabout (Flour Massacre)
sub: Location near the Kuwait Roundabout in Gaza City where at least 112 Palestinians were killed on February 29, 2024 while waiting for aid trucks. Disputed: Israel says crowd stampede, Palestinians say soldiers opened fire.

label: UNRWA Jabalia School Shelters
sub: Multiple UNRWA school buildings in Jabalia used as shelters for displaced Palestinians. Several struck in Israeli airstrikes, including strikes in May and June 2024. UN condemned each strike as a violation of international law.

label: Al-Rashid Street (Coast Road)
sub: Main coastal road running along Gaza's western coastline. Designated as humanitarian evacuation route at various points. Flooded with displaced Palestinians moving south. Scenes of mass civilian displacement throughout the war.

label: Zikim (IDF Staging Area)
sub: Area north of Gaza used by IDF as staging ground for northern Gaza ground operations. IDF troops assembled and launched incursions from border areas near Zikim and Yad Mordechai.

label: Kerem Shalom Rocket Strike (Jun 2024)
sub: Hamas rocket attack on Kerem Shalom crossing on June 1, 2024 killed four Israeli soldiers and damaged aid trucks waiting to enter Gaza. Israel temporarily closed the crossing in response, halting humanitarian aid.

label: Re'im Military Base
sub: Israeli military base near the Nova festival site attacked on October 7 by Hamas. The base was briefly overrun before IDF forces repelled attackers. Many festival-goers sought refuge near the base.

label: Netivot
sub: Israeli city struck by Hamas rockets throughout the war. Located east of Gaza. Missile attacks caused evacuations and civilian anxiety though Iron Dome intercepted most rockets.

label: Ashkelon
sub: Israeli coastal city north of Gaza repeatedly targeted by Hamas rockets. Multiple direct hits on residential buildings despite Iron Dome. Thousands of residents evacuated. Hospital basement converted to emergency facility.

label: Ben Gurion International Airport
sub: Israel's main international airport. Several long-range rockets from Gaza and Hezbollah missiles targeted the airport area during the conflict. Multiple airlines suspended Israel flights during periods of escalation.

label: Jerusalem / Al-Quds
sub: Holy city and flashpoint for the Israel-Palestine conflict. Al-Aqsa Mosque compound remains center of tension. Protests and clashes erupted in East Jerusalem after October 7. Capital claimed by both Israel and Palestinians.

label: Jenin Refugee Camp (West Bank)
sub: Major refugee camp in the West Bank; site of large-scale IDF Operation Iron Wall in January 2025. Weeks-long operation killed dozens, displaced 40,000+ Palestinians, and left the camp largely destroyed. Previously a major militant stronghold.

label: Tulkarm (West Bank)
sub: West Bank city and refugee camp subject to major IDF operations in 2024–2025. Displaced Palestinian residents; infrastructure damaged. Part of broader Israeli counter-terrorism campaign in the West Bank concurrent with Gaza war.

label: Sinwar Family Home (Khan Younis)
sub: Childhood home area of Yahya Sinwar in Khan Younis. IDF targeted the area early in the Khan Younis offensive believing senior Hamas leaders were hiding there. Symbol of the hunt for Hamas leadership.

label: Cairo (Ceasefire Negotiations)
sub: Egyptian capital and one of two primary venues for Gaza ceasefire negotiations (alongside Doha). Egypt's intelligence service served as key mediator. Multiple rounds of indirect talks between Israel and Hamas delegations held in Cairo.

label: Doha (Hamas HQ & Negotiations)
sub: Qatari capital hosting Hamas Political Bureau and primary ceasefire negotiation venue. Qatar's foreign ministry served as main interlocutor between Hamas and Israeli negotiators. Site of Phase 1 ceasefire deal finalized January 2025.

label: ICJ — The Hague
sub: Seat of the International Court of Justice where South Africa filed genocide case against Israel. ICJ issued provisional measures in January and March 2024, and ordered halt to Rafah operation in May 2024. Major legal front of the conflict.

label: Red Sea / Suez Approach
sub: Houthi attacks on shipping in the Red Sea and Bab el-Mandeb Strait forced commercial vessels to reroute. Global trade disruption; shipping costs surged. US-led Operation Prosperity Guardian conducted strikes on Houthi positions in Yemen.

label: Al-Zeitoun Quarter (Gaza City)
sub: Southeastern neighborhood of Gaza City; particularly heavily bombed. Major Hamas tunnel infrastructure discovered by IDF. Scenes of widespread destruction throughout the ground operation.

label: Al-Nasr Hospital (North Gaza)
sub: Children's hospital in northern Gaza; one of the first hospitals to close due to lack of fuel and supplies in October 2023. WHO reported neonatal patients died after life-support machines failed.

label: Wadi Gaza (Central Divide)
sub: Natural geographic barrier dividing northern and southern Gaza. IDF used the Wadi as part of its strategy to segment Gaza. Crossing points controlled and monitored by IDF during ground operations.

label: UNRWA Shelter Schools (Nuseirat)
sub: Multiple UNRWA school buildings used as shelters in Nuseirat camp. Site of June 2024 hostage rescue operation that killed 274+ civilians. Repeated strikes on UNRWA-designated facilities drew international condemnation.

label: Nahal Oz (IDF Post)
sub: Small kibbutz and IDF military base on the Gaza border. Attacked on October 7; IDF observation soldiers (mostly young women) were killed and captured. Multiple hostages taken from here.

label: Kibbutz Nir Oz
sub: Small kibbutz where approximately 25% of residents were either killed or kidnapped on October 7 — the highest proportion of any community. Some entire families were taken hostage. Community largely destroyed and evacuated.

label: Nova Memorial (Re'im)
sub: Memorial established at the site of the Nova music festival massacre. Became major gathering place for hostage families and vigils. Represents the October 7 tragedy in Israeli public consciousness.

label: UNRWA Al-Fakhoura School
sub: UNRWA school in Jabalia used as shelter for thousands of displaced persons. Struck in Israeli airstrike in January 2024, killing over 100 people. UN condemned attack; IDF said militants were using the facility.

label: Abu Yousef al-Najar Hospital (Rafah)
sub: Main hospital in Rafah. Became overwhelmed as over 1.4 million people crowded into the city. Operated far beyond capacity during the Rafah offensive. Severely damaged and evacuated during Israeli operations.

label: Gush Katif Corridor (Western Gaza)
sub: Western coastal strip of Gaza running along the former Gush Katif settlements. IDF maintained military presence along this corridor. Used as staging area for operations in Rafah and Khan Younis.

label: IDF Central Gaza Positions
sub: Central Gaza IDF positions established during Phase 2 operations in 2024. Multiple divisions rotated through operations in central Gaza targeting tunnel systems and remaining Hamas infrastructure.

label: Nablus (West Bank)
sub: West Bank city with significant Palestinian militant activity post-October 7. IDF conducted repeated operations in the old city and refugee camps. Lion's Den and other armed groups based here. Home to Joseph's Tomb, a contested holy site.

label: Ramallah (Palestinian Authority)
sub: De facto capital of the Palestinian Authority, seat of Mahmoud Abbas's government. Under increased security threats from Hamas and Israeli settler violence. PA struggling to maintain legitimacy and coordinate with international partners.

label: Beersheba (IDF Southern Command)
sub: Location of IDF Southern Command headquarters and principal command center for the Gaza ground operation. Coordinated all divisions and units operating in Gaza from this facility.

label: Hostages Square (Tel Aviv)
sub: Renamed plaza in Tel Aviv where hostage families and supporters gather every week demanding a deal. Thousands attend weekly vigils. Symbol of public pressure on Netanyahu's government to prioritize hostage return over war objectives.

label: Kerem Shalom Aid Management Zone
sub: Israeli COGAT (Coordination of Government Activities in the Territories) manages humanitarian aid at Kerem Shalom. Became focus of intense international scrutiny over aid denial allegations. US established a joint mechanism here to monitor aid.

label: Hebron / Al-Khalil (West Bank)
sub: West Bank's largest city and major center of settler-Palestinian tension. Settler violence significantly increased after October 7 with IDF providing cover. Home to the Cave of the Patriarchs / Ibrahimi Mosque — a divided holy site.

label: Rimal Quarter (Gaza City)
sub: Upscale neighborhood of Gaza City housing diplomatic offices, banks, and media centers. Heavily bombed including strikes on Al Jazeera offices. Near total destruction by end of 2023 northern Gaza campaign.

label: Hatzerim IAF Base
sub: Main Israeli Air Force base near Beersheba launching airstrikes on Gaza. F-35I Adir jets flew combat missions from this base. Home to IAF aerobatics team and major strike aircraft.

label: Kibbutz Alumim
sub: Small kibbutz near Gaza border attacked on October 7. Residents sheltered in safe rooms as militants entered the community. Several killed; community evacuated.

label: Khan Younis Police Vehicle Strike (Apr 25)
sub: Israeli airstrike on a police vehicle near a wedding hall in Khan Younis, April 25, 2026. Killed 7 including 4 police officers and 3 civilian bystanders. Gaza interior ministry condemned the strike as 'unprecedented bloody, fascist conduct.'

label: Sheikh Radwan Strike (Apr 25)
sub: Israeli strike near a bank in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, April 25, 2026. Killed 3 including 2 police officers. IDF claimed Hamas militants were targeted.

label: Sheikh Radwan Airstrike (May 6, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrike in the Sheikh Radwan neighborhood of northern Gaza City on May 6, 2026 killed one Palestinian and wounded two others. One of three Israeli strikes that day killing a total of 3 Palestinians, bringing the post-ceasefire death toll to ~832.

label: Hamas Ops Commander Baroud Killed — Gaza City (May 17, 2026)
sub: IDF targeted airstrike in Gaza City killed Bahaa Baroud, Hamas operations division commander, on May 17, 2026 (Day 949 / Day 7 of renewed campaign). IDF stated Baroud 'advanced many attacks against troops and Israeli civilians' and 'posed an immediate threat to IDF troops.' Third senior Hamas commander eliminated in five days following Sinwar (May 13) and Haddad (May 16).

label: Khan al-Ahmar Evacuation Order (May 19, 2026) — West Bank E1 Corridor
sub: Israeli Finance Minister Bezalel Smotrich issued an order on May 19, 2026 to evacuate Khan al-Ahmar, a Bedouin Palestinian village of ~250 residents in the E1 corridor east of Jerusalem (West Bank Area C). The order was Smotrich's defiant response to the ICC prosecutor's request for an arrest warrant against him — the third against an Israeli official. Khan al-Ahmar has been under Israeli demolition orders since 2018; its evacuation would sever contiguous Palestinian territory between Ramallah and Bethlehem, undermining a two-state solution.

label: IDF Sniper Kills Samih Dardouna — Jabalia Camp (May 25, 2026)
sub: IDF sniper fire killed Samih Dardouna, 23, near a clinic in Jabalia refugee camp on May 25, 2026 (Day 957). A relative said Dardouna was searching for food to feed his displaced children when he was shot.

label: 8-Year-Old Hani Shakshak Killed — Northwest Gaza (May 25, 2026)
sub: The body of 8-year-old Hani Abdullah Shakshak was recovered from a tent in the Al Tuwam area of northwest Gaza following Israeli overnight airstrikes on May 25, 2026 (Day 957).

label: Naval Fire on Fishermen — Gaza Coastline (May 25, 2026)
sub: Israeli naval vessels fired heavy machine-gun rounds toward Palestinian fishermen off Gaza's coast on May 25, 2026 (Day 957), wounding three fishermen.

label: Seaport Cafe Strike — Gaza City (Aug 18, 2026)
sub: Israeli airstrike hit a crowded cafe at Gaza City's port displacement camp on August 18, 2026, killing 6 (incl. 1 child) and wounding 14. IDF claimed it targeted a meeting of Hamas Nukhba Force commanders.

label: Uganda/Burundi ISF Site Survey — Rafah (Aug 18, 2026)
sub: Senior Uganda and Burundi military officers conducted a pre-deployment site survey in Rafah on August 18, 2026, amid talks to contribute troops to the International Stabilization Force.

label: Nuseirat Strike — Hamas Commander Killed (Aug 19, 2026)
sub: Israeli strike on Nuseirat refugee camp killed a Hamas company commander the IDF said took part in the October 7, 2023 attack.

label: Police Station Strike — Gaza City (Aug 19, 2026)
sub: Israeli strike hit a Gaza City police station on August 19, 2026, killing 9 (8 police officers and 13-year-old Dana al-Jamasi) and wounding 15.

label: Mass Funeral, Al-Ahli Cemetery — 50 Recovered Victims (Aug 20, 2026)
sub: Thousands attended a mass funeral in Gaza City on August 20, 2026 for 50 Palestinians (incl. 19 children) recovered from rubble of December 2023 strikes; buried at Al-Ahli cemetery, Zeitoun.

label: Yellow Line Shooting — Southern Gaza (Aug 21, 2026)
sub: IDF troops shot a Palestinian who crossed into the IDF-controlled area beyond the Yellow Line in southern Gaza and approached soldiers.

label: Mosque & Desalination Plant Strike — Sheikh Radwan (Aug 24, 2026)
sub: Israeli strike hit a mosque and water desalination plant in Gaza City's Sheikh Radwan neighborhood, cutting potable water access for thousands of displaced families.

label: Abu Salim Mosque Destroyed — Deir al-Balah (Aug 24, 2026)
sub: IDF strike destroyed the historic Abu Salim Mosque, saying it targeted a Hamas weapons-storage facility inside.

label: Al-Bureij Refugee Camp Strike (Aug 24, 2026)
sub: Strike killed 4-year-old Hassan al-Hafi, one of two children among 7 Palestinians killed across Gaza that day.

label: Home Strike Near Kamal Adwan Hospital — Beit Lahiya (Aug 25, 2026)
sub: Strike on a home near Kamal Adwan Hospital in Beit Lahiya killed 3 Palestinians.

label: Drone Strike — Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis (Aug 25, 2026)
sub: Drone strike hit a civilian gathering in al-Mawasi west of Khan Younis, killing 1 and wounding 3.

label: Drone Strike on Displacement Tent — Khan Younis (Aug 26, 2026)
sub: Drone strike hit a tent sheltering displaced people in Khan Younis, killing 1 Palestinian.

label: Shati Camp Strike — Cmdr Raqi'i Killed (Aug 27, 2026)
sub: IDF strike on Shati refugee camp kills Hamas anti-tank unit commander Bilal Ibrahim Saleh Raqi'i.

label: Khan Younis Strike — Cmdr Abadala Killed (Aug 27, 2026)
sub: IDF strike in southern Gaza kills Hamas Khan Younis Brigade member Azzam Rifaat Abd Abadala.

label: Drone Strike — Al-Mawasi, Khan Younis (Aug 27, 2026)
sub: Drone strike hits a displacement tent in al-Mawasi, western Khan Younis, killing 1.

label: Drone Strike — Al-Sinaa Intersection, Gaza City (Aug 27, 2026)
sub: Drone strike targets an electric bicycle at the Al-Sinaa intersection, killing 1 and critically injuring several.

label: Drone Strike — Ansar Junction, Gaza City (Aug 26, 2026)
sub: Israeli drone strike near the Ansar junction, west of Gaza City, kills 1 Palestinian.
